ai_insights.executive_summary: Craigslist.org has a poor SEO score of 42/100 with several critical technical issues affecting search visibility and user experience. The site suffers from multiple H1 tags, suboptimal title length, insufficient meta description, missing social media optimization, and extremely slow page load times that will significantly impact search rankings and user engagement.

weak_points.title: Title tag too long and will be truncated in search results
weak_points.why_it_matters: Truncated titles reduce click-through rates and may not convey the full value proposition to searchers, directly impacting organic traffic
weak_points.root_cause: Title tag is 79 characters when Google typically displays only 50-60 characters in search results
fix_steps: Prioritize most important keywords at the beginning
Consider location-specific titles for better local SEO

weak_points.title: Meta description too short and underutilized
weak_points.why_it_matters: Short meta descriptions miss opportunities to include compelling copy and keywords that could improve click-through rates from search results
weak_points.root_cause: Meta description is only 115 characters when Google allows up to 155-160 characters

weak_points.title: Multiple H1 tags confuse search engines
weak_points.why_it_matters: Multiple H1 tags dilute the page's main topic signal to search engines, potentially harming rankings for primary keywords
weak_points.root_cause: Page contains 2 H1 tags instead of the recommended single H1 per page
fix_steps: Identify the primary H1 that represents the main page topic
Convert secondary H1 to H2 or H3
Ensure proper heading hierarchy (H1 > H2 > H3)
Review content structure for logical flow

weak_points.title: Missing Open Graph image reduces social media visibility
weak_points.why_it_matters: Missing og:image means poor presentation when shared on social media, reducing click-through rates and social engagement
weak_points.root_cause: No og:image meta tag is present in the page head
fix_steps: Create or select a representative image (1200x630px recommended)
Add og:image meta tag with absolute URL

weak_points.title: Extremely slow page load time severely impacts SEO and user experience
weak_points.why_it_matters: 9.3 second load time is far above Google's recommended 2-3 seconds, directly harming search rankings and causing high bounce rates
weak_points.root_cause: Page takes 9320ms to load, indicating server performance issues, unoptimized code, or resource bottlenecks

quick_wins: Shorten title tag to under 60 characters while keeping key terms
Expand meta description to 150-155 characters with compelling copy
Fix multiple H1 tags by converting one to H2
Add og:image meta tag with appropriate social sharing image
